user_stories.title: Save Common Crawl WARC records and raw HTML
user_stories.description: Save Common Crawl WARC records and raw HTML

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The ledger has exactly one row per D01 candidate in the frozen order. Final rows are marked succeeded or failed with a reason.
The first five records have documented checks for range retrieval, compression, and saving and reading back the original HTML.

For each success, the input location, received length, WARC URL, type, internal HTTP 200, and HTML and WARC hashes can be verified. Publication, crawl, and save timestamps are stored in separate fields.
The ledger retains failure reasons, attempt history, retry limits, and wait deadlines. An independent reviewer checks total counts and hashes of saved files.
